messages:
maria: PR #432 merged to main — ready for deploy window. We need to unpin router from v1.2.3 and ramp feature flag nn-serving-v2 during the rollout. Plan I'm proposing: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m observation between steps. @kevin can you kick off the flag toggles when deploy-bot reports canary ok?

deploy-bot: Deploy started for service inference-runtime — commit abc1234. Rollout id r-2026-03-10-11. Status: canary initialization.

kevin: on it. I suggest 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (15m checks). If any sig>2 alerts or p95 > 400ms we stop and rollback.

jonathan: +1 for that ramp. Also recommend pinning traffic to abc1234 for the first hour so we don't get cross-version noise from autoscaling. Unpin after second successful step.

sre-oncall: TL;DR rollback trigger: p95 latency > 400ms OR error-rate spike > 0.5% sustained for 2 mins. If that happens flip nn-serving-v2 back to 0% and pin routing to abc122f (previous stable). I'll be watching metrics.

kevin: executing first toggle now.

kevin: ```bash
# toggle nn-serving-v2 -> 1%
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/toggles 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"flag":"nn-serving-v2","env":"prod","percent":1,"reason":"canary step 1 after deploy start"}'
```

deploy-bot: Rollout update: canary routing applied — nn-serving-v2: 1% traffic -> v2. Logs: canary group healthy.

maria: thanks. watching traces. please annotate any anomalous outputs in the PR thread so QA can follow.

kevin: now scheduling automated check in 15m. If green I will bump to 10%. If borderline, I'll hold and ping.

jonathan: note to release notes: "nn-serving-v2 enabled gradual rollout; router pinned to abc1234 for 1h; canary increments at 1/10/50/100% with 15m observation windows."

sre-oncall: rollback command if needed:```bash
# rollback to 0%
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/toggles 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"flag":"nn-serving-v2","env":"prod","percent":0,"reason":"automated rollback - latency/error thresholds exceeded"}'
# pin router back to previous stable
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/pin 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_KEY' 
  -d '{"service":"inference-runtime","pin":"abc122f"}'
```

kevin: noted. will escalate to #incidents if I hit >2 alerts.

maria: small FYI — leave old model artifacts in cache for 2h to avoid cold misses during rollback.

jonathan: added annotation to deployment doc and will follow up with a short blurb for the changelog.

kevin: bumping to 10% now (manual toggle).

deploy-bot: Rollout update: nn-serving-v2 -> 10% applied. Canary group stable.

sre-oncall: all quiet from metrics so far. continue.

kevin: next step target 50% in ~30m unless we see drift. I'll post each toggle. :white_check_mark:
